en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a riverside scene in a European town. On the left is a large, ornate multi‑story building with arched windows and trees lining a walkway protected by a metal railing above a stone embankment. On the right side of the river stand smaller residential and commercial buildings closely packed along the water. In the distance, more town buildings rise on a gentle hill. The lower margin contains printed captions identifying the location and the publisher.
